top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a mature, clinically validated body of work: Holst's physiology of GLP-1 as an incretin, Mojsov's identification of the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) form, and Drucker's work on GLP-1 biology, which together made possible incretin-based treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity. The achievement is transformative and its three-laureate allocation with a citation scoped to physiology and the active peptide form is defensible, so it is clearly preferable to no award.
